limitations: The prior to exhaustion retains the last powered control; no new post-00:11 powered commands are added.

Public attached-flow polars do not validate stalled or compressible terminal flight. Declared envelope exits are retained as unresolved outcomes.
Point-mass flight-path angle is not body pitch. Body attitude, breakup, water-entry impulse and acoustic coupling remain unresolved.
R600 BTO geometry is explicitly scored when requested; no final BFO, calibrated restart timing or geographic posterior weighting is applied.
Weather below 500 ft is explicitly clamped to the lowest grid level.
